name: trading
description: Trading / financial logic (prop-hedge etc.). Correctness, numerical accuracy, and risk handling are paramount; silent wrong numbers are the worst outcome.
provenance: Market data, trade parameters, and strategy logic in the prop-hedge system.
trust: Data feeds are semi-trusted (can be malformed/stale); strategy logic is ours.
threat_model: Primary risk is CORRECTNESS, not adversarial input: wrong sign, off-by-one on position sizing, unit/precision errors, stale data treated as fresh, unhandled NaN/zero. Flag these as blocking.
scale: Normal; latency matters for live decisions but correctness dominates.
non_goals: Defending against adversarial external attackers (this is internal trading code)
invariants: Never silently produce or act on an unverified/wrong number
Do not recommend changes that mask errors (e.g. swallowing exceptions, defaulting bad data to zero) — surface them
exclusions: Generic web-security hardening (injection/XSS) unless the code actually handles external untrusted input
